title: Hindawi 2026.10: the Hindawi programming system for every language and script, on the original Chintamani pipeline
description: Hindawi 2026.10 carries the Hindawi programming system forward from Chintamani's original pipeline: native source, Romenagri, the language's shaili transducers, then the host toolchain, forward and reverse. It holds the language cells for 76 languages across the nine shailis, Grok's tools for ingesting existing code with a dictionary that names identifiers in the language, and a multi-file gcc front end, both put on the original chain. A fundamental regression proves, by execution, that Chintamani's copy is unchanged, every original shaili goes to its host and back, a multi-file project is ingested, compiled with gcc's flags and reversed, and a native name reaches the ELF symbol and returns through Romenagri. Upstream checks bring in SeaBIOS under system QEMU, a Shakti-class RISC-V target and the Linux kernel, pass or fail. BUILD-0102 is kept as received, and every later change is one commit, recorded with its paths and hashes in CHANGE-LOG.md. Chintamani's components keep their GPL-2.0-or-later licence. Version 2026.10.1 adds BURP, the Bidirectional Universal Resource Parser: ingestion of existing projects into any number of languages at once and back exactly, and building them through hindawicc.
